notes.title: Update! New enemies, new upgrades, new powerups & new UI!
notes.notes:
Bitten Toast Games brings a major update to Spacecats with Lasers VR. New enemies, upgrades and a fully revamped interface that will make your experience even better! 

New in game currency: the more enemy waves you push back, more credits you get to customize your Spacecat just the way you want!

An improved tutorial will make sure that new players will hit the ground running in no time!

Oh, and while you're destroying those evil rats keep your ears peeled for the new tracks Thiago added to our soundtrack!
